Scorecard terms and methodology

What counts

Merged PR
A pull request merged in the selected UTC window. Bot-authored PRs are excluded.
Time to merge
Time runs from the final Ready for review event to merge, or from creation if the PR opened ready and never went back to draft. The median, p75, and p90 are the times by which roughly 50%, 75%, and 90% of PRs with valid timing had merged.
Bot
An account GitHub marks as a bot, an account with a login ending in [bot], or the opentelemetrybot automation account.
Finding
A distinct bug, test coverage gap, or improvement raised in inline review before merge.
Automated Finding
A finding from GitHub Copilot or another configured review bot.$custom_reviewers
